item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00466","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C25","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is a near-verbatim predecessor using the same emergency-board machinery for an airline labor dispute. It shares the child's three-part recital sequence, the exact description that the dispute threatens interstate commerce so as to deprive “a section of the country” of essential transportation service, the thirty-day reporting requirement, and the section 10 status-quo provision. Only the carrier, employee representative, and date are materially changed. C25 is also especially strong because it concerns an airline whose employees are represented by the same pilots' association, while C23 supplies the same framework for another airline dispute, but
